The shared pathway involving Zonisamide and Cyp2c19 is further supported by its inclusion in pathways related to decreased central nervous system disorganized electrical activity, which also involves Fosphenytoin and Primidone, both of which bind to Cyp2c19. These findings collectively indicate that Zonisamide may influence Cyp2c19 function, potentially through a common mechanism of enzyme interaction. The evidence suggests a plausible, biologically relevant relationship between Zonisamide and Cyp2c19, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be elucidated. The presence of multiple pathways converging on Cyp2c19 underscores the importance of this enzyme in drug metabolism and highlights the potential for Zonisamide to affect its activity.
